Travel information

Closest airports

There are multiple options for flying in:

  • Asheville (AVL) - 1 hour 20 minutes from venue
  • Charlotte (CLT) - 3 hours from venue
  • Atlanta (ATL) - 3 hours from venue

Where to stay

The venue is located in Glenville, NC. Other nearby towns include Cashiers, Highlands, and Sapphire. There are many hotels and short term rentals, like AirBNBs in the area.

We suggest looking for accommodation early.
